service.description: Whether git hosting is in this build (ec.factory.hasFeature('git'), as `moqui version` lists the build's features): the Code screens show "Code hosting is not in this build" when not.

actions.script: available = !!ec.factory.hasFeature('git')

service.description: A repository for its screens: what the user may do in it (org.moqui.git.GitServices.get#GitRepositoryAccess: view, create, update, delete; archived), its row's public fields (no credentials), the projects it is linked to that the user sees, its clone URLs, and whether the user is an administrator (mirror, storage, export). Nothing but canView false for a repository the user may not view or that is not there.

The Repositories list (design-projects.md §7 Repositories): the repositories the user may view (find#GitRepositories), by chip: mine (linked to a project the user is on, the default), all (not archived), mirrors (remote, not archived) and archived; text in the id or description; paged by 25. Each row with its projects, storage, default branch, last change, open merge requests and clone URLs. counts by chip.

Of the work efforts a code record is linked to (a commit, branch, tag or merge request), those the user sees, decided here with authorization off (mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#VisibleProjectInfo), so a link never names a work item the user may not open: a project the user sees, a milestone, release or sprint of one, or a work item of one that is not Restricted or Confidential (unless the user manages its project or holds a role on it); for a client contact (isClient) only its client projects and the items shared with it (itemVisibilityIds). effortMap: workEffortId to {workEffortId, workEffortName, statusId, workEffortTypeEnumId, rootWorkEffortId}. A check that fails sees nothing.

Repositories' and ProjectCode's NewRepository: a repository of a project (mantle.work.GitServices.create#ProjectRepository, with the organization's repository defaults), for those who manage the project; without a project, for administrators only (a GitRepository row and init#GitRepository). importUrl, for a database repository, copies a branch with its history from a URL (import#GitRepository).
Link a repository to a project (LinkRepository): for one who manages the project and may change the repository's settings (its delete right), since the project's members get its rights.
Unlink a repository from a project, for one who manages the project; the links of its commits and refs stay.

actions.script: ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#ProjectAccess').parameters({workEffortId, need: 'manage'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.GitServices.remove#ProjectRepository').parameters({workEffortId, repositoryId}).disableAuthz().call() if (!ec.message.hasError()) message = ec.resource.expand('${repositoryId} unlinked from ${workEffortId}', '', {repositoryId, workEffortId})

service.description: MirrorRepository (administrators): a read-only mirror of a repository hosted elsewhere (kind remote, the access token kept encrypted), fetched once now (init#GitRepository) and every fetchIntervalMinutes after, and linked to a project when one is given.
The ref picker's options: the branches (the default first) and the tags, each as {key, text, group}.

RepositoryFiles (design-projects.md §7): the directory at a path in a ref (get#GitTree, directories first, each with its last commit) with its README (README.md, else README), or the file there (get#GitBlob): text with its language from the name, an image, or a binary or a file kept in LFS to download. crumbs: the path's directories. Nothing found: found false.

RepositoryCommits (design-projects.md §7): the log of a ref, or of a path in it (get#GitLog, 30 a page after afterCommitId), each commit with its linked work items (WorkEffortGitCommit of the work items the user sees) and its combined CI state (get#GitCommitStatuses).

The work items linked to commits of a repository (WorkEffortGitCommit), the ones in projects the user sees: itemsByCommit, a map of commitId to [{workEffortId, workEffortName, statusId, linkSourceEnumId}].

RepositoryBranches (design-projects.md §7): the branches, the default first and the others by their last commit, newest first; for the 20 most recently changed ahead and behind the default (get#GitCompare); each with its work item (WorkEffortGitRef), its open merge request and its CI state.

RepositoryTags (design-projects.md §7): the tags, newest first, each with its commit, date, the tagger and message of an annotated one, and the projects, milestones, releases or items it is linked to (WorkEffortGitRef) that the user sees.

RepositoryTags' Link: a tag (or branch) to a project, milestone, release or work item the user may work in (its project's ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#ProjectAccess update), in a repository the user may push to.
Remove a ref's link to a work effort, for one who may work in its project and push to the repository.
RepositoryActivity (design-projects.md §7): the push log (find#GitUpdates), 20 a page, each with its refs changed and the state of its rules.

RepositorySettings (design-projects.md §7) for its maintainers (the delete right) and administrators: the branch rules (get#GitBranchRules), the webhooks (find#GitWebhooks, no secrets) with their last delivery, and the branches to choose the default from. canChange false and nothing else for the others.

Compare (design-projects.md §7): base (the default branch unless given) against head with their diffs and a trial merge (get#GitCompare); every diff up to 25 files, past that the file list and the one asked for (diffPath). In comparison: aheadBy, behindBy, insertions, deletions, fileCount, mergeable, alreadyMerged, fastForward, conflictPaths. With the new merge request's defaults: the title (the source branch's work item's, else the first commit's summary), the description (the work items named, each a Closes line), the reviewers (the leads of the repository's projects who may view it, not the user), complete linked items on merge (the project's WstMergeRequestMoves), and an open merge request of the same branches.

Compare's NewMergeRequest: org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices.create#MergeRequest (the user's push right, one open request per source and target), then its work items linked (mantle.work.GitServices.link#MergeRequestItems) with completeItems as chosen.

CommitDetail (design-projects.md §7): the commit (get#GitCommit) with its files, every diff up to 25 files and past that the one asked for (get#GitCommitDiff), the linked work items the user sees, the CI statuses by context (get#GitCommitStatuses). found false when the repository has no such commit.
CommitDetail's Link to work item: a commit of a repository the user may view to a work item of a project the user works in (mantle.work.GitServices.add#TaskCommit).
CommitDetail's Unlink, for one who works in the item's project and may view the repository.

ProjectCode (design-projects.md §4): the project's repositories the user may view (with their clone URLs), their open merge requests, the default branches' last commits (ten each, the newest 15 together) and the tags linked to the project, its milestones and releases. Each part on its own.

GitAccess (design-projects.md §7): the user's SSH keys (UserSshKey) and access tokens (UserLoginKey with a description), whether the user may use SSH (SSH_GIT), and how to clone: the HTTPS and SSH URLs of a repository the user may view, else of a made-up one, and the account's email for git config.

CodeSettings (design-projects.md §12): the organization's repository defaults (mantle.work.GitServices get#RepositoryDefaults, with the defaults filled in), its commit and branch conventions (the PartySetting ProjConventions: keywordComplete, branchPattern, mergeRequestMoves), and the user groups with whether they hold SSH_GIT.
The organization's repository defaults (PartySetting ProjRepositoryDefaults, short keys to fit its 255 characters, impl-projects.md F9), for the Projects managers.

The organization's commit and branch conventions (PartySetting ProjConventions, which the projects' own WstKeywordComplete, WstBranchPattern and WstMergeRequestMoves fall back to), for the Projects managers.

parameter.name: branchPattern
parameter.description: Names the item with <id> or <KEY>-<n>; kept as text, shown escaped

service.description: CodeSettings' SshAccess: grant SSH_GIT to a user group, or revoke it (its UserGroupPermission ended), for the Projects managers; ADMIN's grant does not change here.

The palette's Code group (Projects.xml palette-source): mantle.work.GitServices.search#Code as rows with title, subtitle, icon and the /qapps link of RepositoryDetail or MergeRequestDetail. None for a client contact, who has no Code screens (impl-projects.md P10).
The labels and colors of the merge request flow, the reviewers' states, the checks and the merge methods, for the Code screens.

MergeRequests (design-projects.md §7) and RepositoryMergeRequests (repositoryId fixed) over org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices.find#MergeRequests (the repositories the user may view), by chip: waiting (open ones whose review the user was asked for and has not given; the default when there are any), mine (the user's own, open or draft), open (open and draft), draft, merged, closed and all; narrowed by text in the title, repository, project (its repositories), author, reviewer and target branch; paged by 25, last updated first. Each row with its number, status, branches, author, reviewers and their states, the head's checks, comments, the linked work items the user sees and when it changed; counts by chip.
The options of the merge requests' find: the repositories the user may view (not archived), the projects the user sees, and the people who wrote or review merge requests of those repositories.

The rows of a merge request list (find#MergeRequests of the framework, already of repositories the user may view) as the screens show them: numText, statusLabel and statusColor, branchText, reviewers with their state labels, the check's label and color, commentCount (the comments filed on it with their replies), the linked work items in projects the user sees (itemList, itemsText), conflict, updatedText.

A merge request for its screens' always-actions, cheap enough for each tab and transition: canView (the user may view its repository; else nothing), its number, title, status, branches and repository, and the repository's canPush and archived.

MergeRequestDetail (design-projects.md §7) for a user who may view its repository (org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices.get#MergeRequest; else found false): the merge request with its labels, the reviewers with their states (and whether each approval is of the current head), the approvals given of required, the head's checks, what keeps it from merging (missingList), the merge methods the target's branch rules allow with the default, whether it would fast-forward, the default squash and merge commit messages, the linked work items the user sees (mantle.work.GitServices.get#MergeRequestItems), its commits with their checks (get#MergeRequestDiff without diffs), the review threads' counts, and what the user may do: edit (its author or a maintainer, while open or draft), merge (push rights and every rule met), review (any viewer comments or requests changes; one who may push, not the author, approves: F132), link work items (who works in their project) and the primary action (Mark ready on a draft, Merge, else Review for a requested reviewer). Each extra part on its own: one that fails is logged and left empty.

parameter.name: parts
parameter.description: Comma separated: items, commits, threads, reviewerOptions; empty: all. The header needs none of them.

service.description: MergeRequestChanges (design-projects.md §7) for a user who may view the repository: the files the merge request changes (get#MergeRequestDiff: path, change, insertions, deletions, and each file's hunks of numbered lines, the line text as data, never html), its review threads by file (mantle.work.GitServices.get#ReviewThreads, each comment with its author and markdown body), the head commit (the viewed marks in the browser are kept per head), and what the user may do (comment while open; review: approve, request changes or comment, an author not approving their own).

MergeRequestDetail's Edit, Mark ready and Mark as draft: org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices.update#MergeRequest (its author or a maintainer, while open or draft); then its work items linked again from the new text (mantle.work.GitServices.link#MergeRequestItems runs on the updated event).

parameter.name: draft
parameter.description: Y a draft, N ready, empty unchanged

service.description: MergeRequestDetail's Add reviewers and Remove: org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices.set#MergeRequestReviewers (its author or a maintainer); the reviewers added are told (the Mantle rule on the service).

actions.script: const added = addUserIds == null ? [] : (Array.isArray(addUserIds) ? addUserIds : (typeof addUserIds === 'object' && addUserIds.length != null ? Array.from(addUserIds) : String(addUserIds).split(','))).map((id) => String(id).trim()).filter((id) => id) if (!added.length && !removeUserId) { ec.message.addError(ec.l10n.localize('Choose a reviewer')); return } ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices.set#MergeRequestReviewers').parameters({mergeRequestId, addUserIdList: added, removeUserIdList: removeUserId ? [removeUserId] : []}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return message = removeUserId ? ec.l10n.localize('Reviewer removed') : ec.l10n.localize('Review requested')

service.description: The review dialog of MergeRequestDetail and MergeRequestChanges: approve, request changes or comment with a summary (org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices.submit#MergeRequestReview, at the current head; the author does not approve their own, and only one who may push approves); the author and reviewers are told (the Mantle rule on the reviewed event).
Close (or with reopen, open again) a merge request: org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices close#MergeRequest, reopen#MergeRequest (its author or a maintainer).

The merge box's Merge: org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices.merge#MergeRequest by the method chosen (the ones the target's branch rules allow), with the squash or merge commit message, deleting the source branch when asked. Needs push rights on the repository and every rule met; refused on a conflict. The linked work items complete as the project and the Closes lines say (the Mantle rule on the merge).

MergeRequestDetail's Link: a work item of a project the user works in (ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#ProjectAccess update) to a merge request whose repository the user may view (mantle.work.GitServices.add#MergeRequestItem), completed on merge when asked.
MergeRequestDetail's Unlink, for one who works in the item's project and may view the repository.

MergeRequestChanges' line comment and reply: mantle.work.GitServices.create#ReviewComment (a comment on a line of the diff, at the head, when path and a line are given; a reply with parentCommEventId), for a user who may view the repository, while the merge request is open or a draft. On a merge request of a repository Smithy keeps the comment is a post of its public conversation, through the post gate: held is true when it waits for a moderator, and it is then in no thread until it is approved.

WorkItemDetail's Development tab for a work item the user sees (ironstone.commons.TaskServices.get#TaskAccess, projects): whether it shows (the item's project has the Code module on or a repository linked); its branches (WorkEffortGitRef of repositories the user may view) with their head, ahead and behind the default branch, open merge request and check; its commits (WorkEffortGitCommit, the newest 30) with their branch and how they were linked; its merge requests (WorkEffortGitMergeRequest) with status, approvals of required and check; its tags; and Create branch: the project's repositories the user may push to, the default name (mantle.work.GitServices.get#TaskBranchName) and whether the user may work on the item. Each part on its own: one that fails is logged and left empty.

WorkItemDetail's Create branch: for one who may work on the item (ironstone.commons.TaskServices.get#TaskAccess update, projects), mantle.work.GitServices.create#TaskBranch in a repository of the item's project (the user's push right and the branch rules apply), from the default branch unless fromRef is given; message with the checkout commands.
